purpose: Independent external evaluation of the existing R0 router. Evaluation only: never used for training, threshold tuning or model selection.

reference_data.note: Every question already used by the project (training, development, protected and sealed tests, RouterArena). External rows in the same duplicate group are excluded.

llmrouterbench.license_status: No LICENSE file in the dataset card or code repository (README shows an MIT badge only). Local research evaluation; raw text and responses are not redistributed in Git.

aime.family_note: xRouteBench aime_2020_2024 is in the development data

mmlupro.family_note: xRouteBench mmlu_pro is in the development data

arenahard.family_note: Score is a pairwise judge preference against a baseline answer (0/0.5/1), not correctness; success means a clear win (1.0)

excluded_datasets.swe-bench/verified: Agentic repository patch task; not a single-turn text query; one pool model missing
excluded_datasets.tau2/test: Multi-turn tool-use task; one pool model missing
excluded_datasets.arc-agi/v1: Serialized grid puzzles without a natural-language query
excluded_datasets.arenahard/test and arenahard_* subsets: Duplicate views of the 750 arenahard prompts
excluded_datasets.aime-bbh-emorynlp-finqa-humaneval-kandk-: No flagship pool results; small open models only, so no cost-comparable tiers

sprout.license_status: No license in the dataset card or the CARROT code repository. Local research evaluation; raw text and responses are not redistributed in Git.
sprout.cost_status: Token counts only; no recorded dollar cost. Quality and label alignment only, no cost metrics.

excluded_datasets.TIGER-Lab/MMLU-Pro: Same family as xRouteBench mmlu_pro and LLMRouterBench mmlupro (primary set keeps the cost-bearing copy)
excluded_datasets.lighteval/MATH/*: Same family as xRouteBench math in the development data
excluded_datasets.rungalileo/ragbench/*: Retrieval-augmented long contexts; RAG is excluded by the project data contract
excluded_datasets.TAUR-Lab/MuSR/*: Story-grounded questions over a provided multi-paragraph narrative (document-grounded, RAG-like input)

token_limits.router_note: ModernBERT router (serving router_max_length=8192). Rows above it are excluded because the router would not see the whole question.
token_limits.cache_note: Serving cache embedder (embed_max_length=512) truncates, it does not fail. Rows above it are kept and flagged within_cache_embed_limit=false for the cache experiment and the full-service-path slice.

context_grounded_exclusion.reason: RAG / provided-document question answering is excluded by the project data contract; a quoted passage that is itself the object of the question is kept
